units.failure:
Act agent reported ok:false: Steps 1–3 are done in game/frontend/src/App.tsx. The boy's `playAnimation` interact event is emitted from the App action handler, which is now wired to `ObjectOverlay onAction`. Baseline: active scan v1, tip 9cda5131c65b08541fc685d8a0898d39a0e9e9fa.

Deviation: App.tsx changed on disk after my edits, from another writer. Their `handleAction` (L68–74) already calls `game.act`, emits `playAnimation {target:'boy', name:'interact'}`, and also emits `transitionTo` when the scene changes. My duplicate handler was in the same scope and caused TS2451. It is gone now, so only their handler remains and it is what `onAction={handleAction}` uses. I did not revert their changes. BootScene.ts also has an uncommitted guard on `transitionTo`, and ContributionSheet.tsx, GameLayout.tsx and styles.css show modifications I did not make.

Not compiling: `npx tsc --noEmit` reports App.tsx(69,20) and App.tsx(72,19), 'Object is possibly null', on `useGameStore.getState().state.currentScene` in the transition lines of the other writer's handler. My playAnimation lines compile. The other ~46 errors are pre-existing: missing zod, implicit any in files I did not touch, and tests. Fixing the two null errors means changing the concurrent transition code, so I left it. Suggested fix: optional chaining or a null guard on `state` in that handler, then re-run tsc.

No tests were written, per the Act rules.
